beats.headline: Twenty out of the bag
beats.text: Carl finally finds the materials for something called Spider Stalkers, which are really just robot rot stickers, a pretty common mob. Their main driveshaft is rare and expensive, and he secures a case on his way out of the Desperado Club. On the raid, Donut is to do the honors. He pours twenty rat-sized automaton spiders from a bag; they roll out like spilled tennis balls, sprout legs and line up. Each exploding one is programmed with a target, Hunter Not Already Targeted, so any kill goes to Donut. Two more he sets on Samantha: explode five seconds after target acquired.

beats.headline: Seekers into the rain
beats.text: You, and you, and you, Donut says, tapping each seeker spider on the head, and they scuttle off into the rain. Samantha rolls off toward the town exit, and on Carl's word Donut taps the last two, and they chase her: the anti-air gun has an anti-seeking enchantment, and the indestructible head is the workaround. Explosions rip through the night as the seekers find targets, and the gun goes up in a red geyser. When it is over, a few spiders walk in circles, unable to find a target. They will run out of power in a few minutes, and Carl will have to collect them and recharge them at his table.

beats.headline: Guts out on the counter
beats.text: Little Bonnie the gnome sits on the counter, humming to herself as she pries the guts out of a disarmed spider automaton. Carl's eyes catch her as he weighs taking the stairs and avoiding what comes next. We need her and the rest of them, he thinks, if we want to survive the ninth floor.

beats.headline: Fifteen, ten already armed
beats.text: Before going in against the undead, Carl readies several of his spider automatons and moves a few of Mordecai's holy gooper grenades to the ready position. He has fifteen spiders, but ten of them are already armed with regular explosives, which makes them useless if the mobs are non-corporeal. The others he can arm with a holy grenade, or just a straight healing potion.

beats.headline: A mouse trap for an elephant
beats.text: With Minge tearing the club apart, Carl dives behind a kitchen station and pulls spider robots from his automaton menu, saved for an emergency: one utility spider and three anti-undead ones begun in the ghommid village. He puts a demon snare in the first one's trap slot and ups its yield. All three automatons reach the demon and activate. The snare, fixed to the spider's top, only attaches the spider to her bulk, and it detonates, splashing her with blood water from Emberus's shrine, while the other two set off holy-water smoke curtains. At level 225 she will not be badly hurt, but it will hurt like hell.

beats.headline: Seekers in the Prism
beats.text: Inside the Prism's headquarters, Carl drops hunter seeker automatons on the floor, and they scatter off into the small castle. Empress D'Nadia sends her three guards out of the throne room the moment they approach. The one Saccathian hides behind the other off-worlder, a gnoll, as the explosive spider automatons close in, and both off-worlders are splattered over the wall before the party arrives. The samurai rhino casts a powerful shield, but the concussions knock him out for ten minutes.
